{"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on:
- civilian protection and proportionality,
- prisoner treatment,
- IHL / humanitarian-law compliance,
- Turkish military operations in Syria, Iraq, and externally supported operations.

I did not find reliable 2024 evidence showing Erdoğan or his government:
- publicly adopted stronger IHL safeguards,
- improved prisoner-treatment standards,
- or clearly constrained military operations on civilian-protection grounds.

So the best-supported reading is negative overall, with the strongest direct evidence coming from Turkey’s Syria/Iraq campaign, proxy abuses in Turkish-occupied areas, and Turkey-linked drone strikes in Somalia.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Türkiye","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey","summary":"HRW says Türkiye intensified its military campaign against the PKK with drone strikes in northern Iraq and northeast Syria; October strikes damaged critical infrastructure and disrupted water and electricity for millions. This is strong evidence against proportionality/civilian-protection discipline in military operations.","question_ids":["2B.4"]},{"title":"Syria: Abuse, impunity in Turkish-occupied territories","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-02-29","url":"https://www.hrw.org/tr/news/2024/02/29/syria-abuses-impunity-turkish-occupied-territories","summary":"HRW says Turkey directly controls the Syrian National Army through weapons, salaries, training, and logistics, while SNA groups and military police arbitrarily detained, forcibly disappeared, tortured, and sexually abused civilians, including women and children. This is direct negative evidence on prisoner treatment and civilian protection.","question_ids":["2B.4"]},{"title":"Somalia: Death of 23 civilians in military strikes with Turkish drones may amount to war crimes – new investigation","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-07","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/somalia-death-of-23-civilians-in-military-strikes-with-turkish-drones-may-amount-to-war-crimes-new-investigation/","summary":"Amnesty says Somali strikes supported by Turkish drones killed 23 civilians, including 14 children, and may amount to war crimes. This is direct evidence against civilian protection and proportionality in Turkey-linked operations.","question_ids":["2B.4"]},{"title":"Türkiye President - Recep Tayyip Erdoğan - Statement summary (excerpts on the situation in oPT) - UN General Assembly - 79th Session","publisher":"UN / UNISPAL","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/unispal/document/turkiye-president-recep-tayyip-unga-79-24sep24/","summary":"Erdoğan’s public rhetoric emphasized ceasefire, humanitarian catastrophe, and stopping escalation in Gaza. This is not military-operations evidence, but it is the closest 2024 material I found that points toward civilian-protection concerns.","question_ids":["2B.4","1B.8"]}]}
